newsitem.title: UK: Ricardo names Goodburn finance director.
newsitem.headline: Ricardo names Goodburn finance director.

text.p: British-based automotive and engineering designer and consultant Ricardo Group Plc said on Tuesday that it has appointed Andrew Goodburn as finance director.

The company said in a statement that the appointment of Goodburn will relieve Rodney Westhead of his additional responsibilities as acting finance director and enable him to focus solely on the chief executive role.
Goodburn is currently finance director of Ricardo consulting engineers, the largest subsidiary within the Ricardo group.
